nodes.description: Public token name string set to ParkCryption.
Public token symbol string set to PARK.
Public uint8 decimals value (18).
Address of the contract owner, assigned to msg.sender in the constructor.
Public uint256 initial supply minted to the deployer.
Public uint256 total token supply, written in _mint.
Mapping of address to token balance; mutated by _transfer and _mint.
Nested mapping of owner to spender to allowance; mutated by approve/increase/decreaseAllowance and transferFrom.
Modifier that requires isOwner() before executing the guarded function body.
Constructor that sets _owner to msg.sender and mints initialSupply to the deployer.
External view returning _balances[owner].
Public view comparing msg.sender to _owner used for access control.
External transfer that delegates to _transfer using msg.sender as sender.
External delegated transfer that checks and decrements the spender allowance before calling _transfer.
Internal transfer that requires sufficient balance and mutates _balances for from and to.
Owner-restricted external function that sets the allowance for a spender.
Owner-restricted external view returning the allowance for an owner-spender pair.
Owner-restricted external function adding addedValue to the caller's allowance for a spender.
Owner-restricted external function subtracting subtractedValue from the caller's allowance for a spender.
Internal mint that sets the balance of an account and rewrites totalSupply.
Caller-controlled address used as owner, sender and allowance key throughout the contract.
Subtraction of value from _allowed[from][msg.sender] in transferFrom without SafeMath (underflow in Solidity 0.6.0).
Subtraction of value from _balances[from] in _transfer without SafeMath (underflow).
Addition of value to _balances[to] in _transfer without SafeMath (overflow).
Addition of addedValue to _allowed[msg.sender][spender] in increaseAllowance without SafeMath (overflow).
Subtraction of subtractedValue from _allowed[msg.sender][spender] in decreaseAllowance without SafeMath (underflow).
